name: Valencia
tagline: Wood-fired rice in L'Albufera, two Michelin stars downtown, and Spain's most photogenic market.

Ricard Camarena Restaurant.description: Valencian produce cuisine of the highest technical level, from chef Ricard Camarena. Two Michelin stars.

El Poblet.description: Rice dishes and avant-garde Mediterranean cuisine right in downtown Valencia. Two Michelin stars.

Arrocería Maribel.description: A rice restaurant in El Palmar, the heart of L'Albufera, the historic birthplace of Valencian paella. Bib Gourmand.

Mercado Central.description: One of Europe's largest covered markets, with stalls for horchata, ham, and fresh seafood.

RiFF.description: Creative, slightly anarchic Mediterranean cuisine from chef Bernd Knöller. Valencia's oldest Michelin star, since 2009.
